extracted.intended_audience: eRA Commons users (signing officials/SO, program director/principal investigators/PD/PI, PIs, FS R roles, and other grant closeout staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural guidance for completing and submitting closeout deliverables in eRA Commons, including Final Invention Statement (FIS), Final RPPR/FRAM, and Federal Financial Report (FFR). Covers who may perform actions, required content, and system interactions (preview, save, submit).

rubrics_metrics.name: Final Invention Statement — submission timing and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: You must submit a Final Invention Statement (FIS) within 120 days following the termination of a grant award. The statement should include all inventions that were conceived or first reduced to practice during the course of work under the grant or award, from the original effective date of support through the date of completion or termination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy: For policy information on awards funded by the Department of Health and Human Services, refer to the Procedure for Submission of Final Invention Statement and Certification. If your award is funded by a non-NIH or non-AHRQ source, check with your awarding agency for policy guidance on final invention statements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Role-based permissions for closeout submissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Only a signing official (SO) or a user with delegated report submit authority can submit the reports or other data; the program director/principal investigator (PD/PI) can upload, preview, delete and save the closeout report submission package, but cannot complete the final step to submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Repeated guidance: Only the SO can submit—the PI does not see a Submit button. Only the PI can initiate the RPPR, and only the SO can submit it. Only SOs or those with delegated authority to submit reports can see the Submit button.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process to add an invention to the Final Invention Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: To add an invention: type the Name of Inventor, Title of Invention, and the Date Reported to DHSS; click the Add Invention and Save button; respond to the Confirm Invention popup (click Agree and Continue even if you have more inventions to add). The invention is then listed under Added Inventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: As long as the final invention statement has not yet been submitted, either a PI or SO who views this screen can click an item's Delete Invention and Save link to remove it. Any inventions you define are saved immediately. NOTE: Click the Preview (Inventions Reported) button to download a PDF copy of the final invention statement form filled out with the entered information and grant information. When all inventions are listed click Submit (only SO) and click Agree and Continue in the confirmation popup. After submission the submitted PDF is available via View on Closeout Status.

rubrics_metrics.name: Process to certify/report no inventions on the Final Invention Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: To certify that no inventions exist: access the Process Final Invention Statement screen, click the Save with No Inventions button, confirm the success message and that the Preview button is renamed to 'Preview (No Inventions Reported)', then click Submit (only SO) and click Agree and Continue in the Certification popup.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A success message appears when you create the FIS with no inventions reported. NOTE: Click the Preview (No Inventions Reported) button to download a PDF copy of the final invention statement form filled out with the entered information and grant information. After submission the submitted PDF is available via View on Closeout Status.

rubrics_metrics.name: FRAM — purpose and triggering conditions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Final Progress Report Additional Materials (FRAM) link provides a means for recipients to enter, review, route, and submit information in response to specific request(s) by the program official (PO) for additional information related to the Final RPPR.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: While reviewing a submitted Final RPPR, the PO might determine that additional materials are required; in this case the PO submits a FRAM request. When a FRAM request is made, the PD/PI is notified via email with a description of the requested material and a FRAM task appears on the Closeout Status screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: FRAM initiation and submit permissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Either the PD/PI or SO can initiate the FRAM and attach a file or type/paste a Revised Project Outcome, but only an SO can submit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only SOs or those with delegated authority to submit reports can finalize and submit the FRAM package. PD/PI can upload, preview, delete and save the closeout submission package but cannot complete the final step to submit.

rubrics_metrics.name: FRAM screen sections and appropriate use
rubrics_metrics.description: The FRAM screen contains two distinct sections: the FRAM Upload Additional Materials section for uploading files, and the Revised Outcome section to type or paste revised text for the RPPR section titled 'I. Outcomes'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Policy guidance appears under the Revised Outcome section to describe what type of description is needed, and the screen contains a link to see samples of acceptable project outcomes. Agency-specific notes: SAMHSA awards do not use FRAM to ask for Revised Project Outcome; SAMHSA awardees should ignore references to Revised Project Outcomes on the FRAM screen.

rubrics_metrics.name: FRAM file upload mechanics and constraints
rubrics_metrics.description: To upload files: drag and drop file(s) into 'Drop Files Here...' or click browse to choose files. The drop area specifies how many files and what file types are allowed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For uploaded files you can click the Download icon and the browser will open or download the file, click the Delete icon to remove the file. If you want to discard the FRAM submission (but not prior submissions) click the Delete button at the bottom of the screen. Save then Preview to download a PDF summary of uploaded files, who uploaded, any revised outcome, and file contents. After submission a View action appears on Closeout Status; FRAM Update remains until acceptance enabling you to upload more files, but you cannot make changes to files already submitted. Email notifications are sent to the SO who submitted, the PI, and the PO. The PO may rescind approval, which will make FRAM Update appear again.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revised Outcome submission specifics
rubrics_metrics.description: To provide a Revised Outcome: read the policy guidance in the Revised Outcome section prior to submitting; type or paste the revised outcome description into the text box provided. Tool icons provide basic editing tools (bold, italic, bullets, numbering, indenting).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agency-Specific Instructions: SAMHSA — The Revised Project Outcome section is not applicable for awards funded by SAMHSA. See NIH notices NOT-OD-17-022 and NOT-OD-17-037 for additional policy guidance on revised outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Financial Report (FFR) requirement and handling
rubrics_metrics.description: The Federal Financial Report (FFR) is required for closeout and should be prepared according to instructions provided by the awarding agency.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Commons users with the FSR role can see the Manage Final FFR action on the Closeout Status screen which redirects to the FFR module. For awards funded by DHHS, the FFR can be initiated from eRA Commons but users are then redirected to the Payment Management System (PMS) to fill out and submit the report; users need appropriate access to PMS. For awards funded by Department of Commerce (DOC), users initiate and fill out the FFR form within eRA Commons.

rubrics_metrics.name: Final RPPR submission process (non-NIH and general)
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit a Final RPPR: log into eRA Commons as the contact PD/PI and access the Closeout Status screen; click Process Final RPPR; if an Initiate button appears click it to start the Final RPPR (only the PI can initiate), then Edit RPPR and fill out forms and Submit it (only SOs can submit).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Notes: The F. Changes form is not applicable for Final RPPRs. The H. Budget form is not applicable for Final RPPRs. The I. Outcomes form is applicable only for Final RPPRs. After initiation an ellipsis menu next to the Award Number provides RPPR actions such as Edit RPPR.

rubrics_metrics.name: Certification, Preview and PDF record guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Before submitting certain closeout items a certification popup appears; you must click Agree and Continue in the popup to complete submission. The Preview button downloads a PDF copy of the submission package.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After final invention statement or FRAM submission, the submitted PDF form is available on the Closeout Status screen via View. Use Save then Preview to see what the FRAM submission includes: summary of files uploaded, person who uploaded, any revised outcome saved, and contents of any uploaded files.

rubrics_metrics.name: Agency-specific closeout differences and instructions
rubrics_metrics.description: Agency-specific instructions affect closeout processes: AHRQ, NIH, SAMHSA, CDC, DOC, VA and others may have different tasks, screens, or applicability (for example SAMHSA does not use FRAM for Revised Project Outcome even though the section appears).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Examples: AHRQ closeout actions include FFR, Final RPPR, Final Invention Statement, FRAM (only if requested). SAMHSA: Revised Project Outcome section not applicable; CDC: list of closeout actions includes Additional Materials. For DHHS-funded FFRs users are redirected to PMS; for DOC-funded FFRs the form is within eRA Commons. Read policy language on the screens carefully as it differs depending on awarding agency's policies.
